tools.name: run_orient
tools.title: Run orient.sh triage
tools.description: Runs the dataiku-diagnosis-reader skill's orient.sh triage script against bundle_root: reports node type/version, the data-dir mirror location, the 10 largest files in the bundle, and presence/size of key troubleshooting files (dmesg.txt, stacks.txt, cgroups_usage.txt, run/sanity-check.json, hs_err_pid* crash dumps, run/audit/). Read-only, no network calls, no changes made. Read the skill-guide resource first to know how to interpret the output.

bundle_root.description: Absolute path to the bundle root (the directory containing diag.txt/timings.txt). Falls back to the DATAIKU_BUNDLE_ROOT env var if omitted.

tools.name: safe_read
tools.title: Guarded file read/grep within a bundle
tools.description: Read a bounded slice of a single file inside a diagnosis bundle, with hard size/line caps and optional regex filtering. Use this instead of trying to load whole manifest/log files - some (datadir_listing.txt, run/*.log.N, run/audit/audit.log.N) are 100MB-2.3GB. See the reference-limitations and reference-listings-and-manifests resources for which files need a pattern.

bundle_root.description: Absolute bundle root; falls back to DATAIKU_BUNDLE_ROOT if omitted.

relative_path.description: Path to the target file, relative to bundle_root (e.g. 'datadir_listing.txt' or 'apps/dss/data_design/config/general-settings.json'). Must resolve inside bundle_root.

pattern.description: Optional JS-flavored regex; only matching lines are returned. Required for files above max_bytes.

pattern_flags.description: Optional regex flags, e.g. 'i'. Default none.
